The predator stalks his prey. Nothing escapes his sight. A Souvenir from Siberia.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month (Or try to take it from Kurt Hansen, your call)

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Armor-Piercing Ammunition, which for this weapon costs the same as Basic Ammunition. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6).

When this weapon performs a Leg Aimed Shot, if the target already has at least one infliction of the Broken Leg Critical Injury, the target instead immediately suffers the Dismembered Leg Critical Injury on the broken leg. This weapon can be reloaded by sacrificing the user’s Move Action as long as they have at least one other free hand.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month (Or try to take it from Kurt Hansen, your call)
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
